The '''Fujari asteroid base''' was an [[asteroid base]] operated by the [[Fujari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. It was destroyed some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Bordal Contagion]], within a [[Standard week/Legends|week's]] span of the destruction of the [[Hajara gang]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />
